title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Paperback Series. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Every option stays black, white, and gray.

options.label: The Paperback Series
options.lineage: Mid-century mathematics paperback series (Dover-style black-and-white covers)
options.thesis: Every guide is a numbered volume in one paperback series, each with its own bold geometric cover drawn from its topic.
options.viewport: A huge series masthead in a heavy grotesque, the library open beside it as numbered volumes with a working subject index you can click.
options.risk: Reads as pastiche if the cover figures become clip-art instead of diagrams of each guide's real topic.

raised.raise: Reader and author stay one step apart: the series always ends on a blank, numbered next volume that is the door to join.
Emptiness is active: each cover holds one off-center figure and leaves the rest of the board deliberately blank.
Layouts snap to whole cover modules and recompose by whole volumes, never fractions.
A back-of-book topic index points into the volumes, so a student can find Euler's formula without knowing which guide holds it.
Numbers own fixed places: volume numbers and counts are set in one fixed-width figure style (No. 001).

options.label: The Typeset Page
options.lineage: LaTeX textbooks: theorem boxes, numbered equations, margin notes
options.thesis: The site reads like the guides themselves: sections, definitions, and theorems set the way LaTeX sets a textbook.
options.viewport: Page one of a textbook: a chapter title, a boxed Definition naming Math Mentors, and the library listed as numbered sections.
options.risk: The literal reading of 'typeset like a book', and close to the editorial serif look most runs land on.

options.label: HyperCard Shoebox Stack
options.thesis: The library as a stack of one-bit cards linked by painted buttons, where reading and making are the same tool.
options.viewport: A single fixed card with a menu bar, a dithered guide cover, and Browse / Open buttons.
options.case: Fits the palette perfectly, but students don't recognize HyperCard and a card stack hides the PDF guides behind a metaphor.
options.risk: Retro-computing novelty over the guides themselves.
options.kept: Reader and author one step apart: the series ends on a blank next volume that is the join door.

options.label: Ikebana Alcove
options.thesis: One asymmetric arrangement in charged empty space.
options.viewport: One off-center figure in a mostly empty field.
options.case: Beautiful restraint, but nothing in it says math, students, or free guides.
options.kept: Emptiness is active: one off-center figure per cover.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.thesis: The library as tiled narrative panels on a strict grid.
options.viewport: Framed panels whose seams grid every scene (cobalt translated to black).
options.case: Losing its cobalt to the palette rule strips most of its character; no tie to math students.
options.kept: Layouts snap to whole modules, never fractions.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Guides plotted as magnitude-ranked points on chart plates.
options.viewport: A dark chart plate with guides as stars (navy translated to near-black).
options.case: Elegant data graphic, but astronomy is the wrong subject and a one-guide sky is empty.
options.kept: An index of named objects pointing into the plates becomes a topic index.

options.label: Signboard Alley
options.thesis: Subjects as stacked, lit floor signs.
options.viewport: A vertical spine of lit subject signs (neon translated to white).
options.case: Needs color and nightlife energy the palette rule removes; nothing to do with studying.
options.kept: The spine is the index: subjects stack as spines you scan at a glance.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: The site as a bank of counting tubes.
options.viewport: Tube banks counting guides and problems (orange glow translated to white).
options.case: Its only warmth is orange glow, which the palette forbids, and a few stats can't carry a page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A friendly education platform landing page, executed impeccably in black and white.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and search over a grid of guide cards, then features, reviews, and a join banner.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other study site by design.
